snippet.title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror | Welcome to Cypress Reel!
snippet.description:
Outbreak: Shades of Horror is now available on Xbox Series X|S and on PC via Steam Early Access!

Take a tour of Cypress Reel, your one stop hub world and lobby for all things Outbreak: Shades of Horror!  Choose your mode, select your character, try out all kinds of weapons, and so much more.

Buy on Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/outbreak-shades-of-horror/9NWPMG6815BC

Buy on Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1932190/Outbreak_Shades_of_Horror/

Xsolla Mall:  https://x.la/outbreak-shades-of-horror
